title: Parikshaa content: shared definitions
description: Pieces every content type uses. See docs/content/CONTENT-FORMAT.md. Keys starting x- are notes for the importer (x-db: where the value is stored today; x-needs-platform: what the platform must add before the value is used).

slug.description: Stable address. Never changes after first upload; a re-upload with the same slug updates the item.

version.description: Starts at 1. Raise by 1 on every change; the same slug and version with different content is refused.

tier.description: public: free for every learner. premium: Plus only.
tier.x-needs-platform: Per-item Plus lock. Today only lessons past a track's free modules are locked (prep.ts #locked); problems are never locked.

text_language.description: Language the learner reads. en = English; hi-Latn = Hinglish (Hindi in Latin script).

level.description: PROBLEM-STANDARD.md section 2. L0/L1 go with easy, L2 with medium, L3/L4 with hard.

source.description: Where the claim comes from: an interview-experience id of ours, or a public, linkable report.

verified.description: Only verified companies may be listed. Unverified: leave the company out.

tags.x-db: practice_problems.tags = topics + patterns + extra (companies go to prep_company_reports)

author.description: Person or team accountable for the item.

tool.description: Name of the tool used, if any. Free text.

originality.description: One or two sentences: the story, statement, tests and editorial are our own; no text copied from another site or book we do not own.

authoring.x-needs-platform: Stored with the item's version (content_items table); not in practice_problems today.

placement.description: Where the item sits in a track. The track itself is declared in the bundle manifest.

variants.description: Per-learner variants. Every string in the item may use {{name}} for a parameter. sets[0] is the default the item is written and checked for; each further set is a variant a learner may be given.
variants.x-needs-platform: Variant expansion at upload (one stored copy per set) and assignment per learner (hash of learner id and slug). Not in the DB today.

hints.description: A ladder: hint 1 nudges, the last one nearly gives the idea. Never code.
hints.x-db: hints[0] -> practice_problems.hint (static rung 1). The rest: x-needs-platform (static rungs 2-3).

starters.description: Starter code by language: a function stub and fast input/output around it, with the right integer width.

checker.description: How output is judged. exact is the default.
checker.x-db: question.checker (custom: Python 3, run as checker.py input expected output; exit 0 accepts)

expect.description: For a wrong solution: the verdict at least one test must give. FAIL: any verdict but pass.

why.description: For a wrong solution: the mistake it makes (int overflow, off-by-one, O(n^2)).

solution.x-needs-platform: Brute and wrong solutions are kept for the gates only; stored with the item version, never shown.

expected.description: Optional: when given, must equal the reference's output. When absent, the reference's output is used.

note.description: What this test is for (author's note, never shown).

io_test.description: A fixed test: standard input and the exact standard output.

editable.description: false: shown read-only (a test driver, data). Default true.

mcq_inline.description: A short question asked inside a lesson or a design case.
mcq_inline.x-db: practice_problems (kind mcq) + prep_lesson_quiz (at most 10 per lesson)

revision_card.x-needs-platform: Authored revision card text; today cards are made from wrong answers only.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for a screen reader.

visual.x-needs-platform: Sketch renderer (LEARN-V2 section 3d). Until then the importer shows alt text and, for dry-run, a table of frames.

code_block.description: Code shown in a lesson. runnable: the learner may press Run; with expected_output, the gates run it and compare.

target_words.description: The owner's checklist sets it per tier and difficulty (INSTRUCTIONS.md). The gate fails below 85% of it.
